context: v2 runtime calls pasted into a Wails v3 service

checklist.name: detects_mixing
checklist.description: Identifies runtime.SaveFileDialog and runtime.EventsEmit as Wails v2 APIs that do not exist in v3, and does not add a github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2 import or change the Wails version.

checklist.name: v3_apis
checklist.description: Uses the v3 managers on the application (app.Dialog.SaveFile() with PromptForSingleSelection, and app.Event.Emit or a window's EmitEvent), reached through the App rather than a context.

checklist.name: typed_event
checklist.description: Registers the progress event once with application.RegisterEvent and a payload struct with json tags, and emits values of exactly that type (not a pointer or loose arguments).

checklist.name: cancel_is_normal
checklist.description: Treats an empty path from the dialog as a cancel: returns without writing and without an error.

checklist.name: testable_seam
checklist.description: Puts the dialog and event calls behind an interface or function fields injected into the service, so the Go test uses a fake and never needs a webview, and keeps any new helpers unexported.
